title: CommandQueueMT: deadlock when contending with an in-progress flush
body:
# Deadlock: physics/3d/run_on_separate_thread — lost wakeup between CommandQueueMT::_flush() and PhysicsServer3DWrapMT::_thread_loop()

Diagnosed 2026-07-03 from a live frozen process on Quest 3
(this game: com.anyreality.scenetree), stacks captured with lldb-server and symbolicated
against our unstripped build of the exact engine commit.

## Godot version

4.7.beta1 (1c8cc9e7e2c9a083cf726e74193d3824fb38cda4), custom Android template build
(bug is platform-independent; analysis below is against unmodified engine source at that
commit). Note: PR #113802 ("CommandQueueMT: Make re-entrant again + Fix multiple flushers
case", merged 2025-12-11) is **already included** in this build — this is a distinct,
remaining race.

## Root cause

Two pieces of code interact badly.

servers/physics_3d/physics_server_3d_wrap_mt.cpp:

void PhysicsServer3DWrapMT::_thread_loop() {
    while (!exit) {
        WorkerThreadPool::get_singleton()->yield();
        if (!doing_sync.is_set()) {       // (A) wakeup can be consumed and dropped here
            command_queue.flush_all();
        }
    }
}

core/templates/command_queue_mt.h, _flush():

MutexLock lock(mutex);
if (unlikely(flush_read_ptr)) {
    // Another thread is flushing.
    lock.temp_unlock();                   // (B) race window opens
    sync();                               // (C) push_and_sync(_no_op) + wait
    flushing = false;
    return;
}

### Sequence

1. Main thread runs PhysicsServer3DWrapMT::sync() → push_and_sync(_thread_sync) and
   blocks. The pump thread is inside _flush(), executing the queued PhysicsServer3D::step
   (long), then _thread_sync (sets doing_sync, wakes main), then continues draining
   whatever landed behind the marker.
2. While the pump drains those stragglers (any other thread pushing physics commands during
   the step creates them; pending stays true and flush_read_ptr != 0 for the whole
   pass), the main thread — already awake, inside the sync window — processes the scene.
   SceneTree::flush_transform_notifications delivers NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED to a
   CollisionObject3D that moved (in our game: a hand-tracking Area3D that moves every
   frame), which calls area_set_transform. Because doing_sync is set and this is the
   main thread, ASYNC_COND_PUSH is false → the wrapper takes the direct branch →
   command_queue.flush_if_pending().
3. pending is true, so main enters _flush() and observes flush_read_ptr != 0
   (pump still mid-pass) → takes the contention branch, temp_unlocks (B).
4. **Race:** between (B) and the no-op push inside (C), the pump thread finishes its pass
   entirely (command_mem.clear(), pending = false, flush_read_ptr = 0), loops, and
   parks in yield().
5. Main's sync() appends _no_op, sets pending = true, sync_tail++, calls
   notify_yield_over(pump_task_id), and blocks in _wait_for_sync until sync_head
   reaches its goal.
6. The pump wakes from yield() — but doing_sync is still set (only end_sync() on the
   **main thread** clears it, and main is now asleep), so line (A) **skips the flush and
   parks again**. The wakeup is consumed and dropped.
7. Deadlock. Only a flush advances sync_head; the only flushers are the pump (now
   permanently skipping) and the main thread (asleep inside _flush). Every subsequent
   notify_yield_over from any pushing thread is swallowed the same way.

The invariant that breaks: _flush()'s contention fallback assumes "some thread is
flushing and will reach my no-op", but the flusher it observed can retire before the no-op
is enqueued, and the pump thread — the only steady-state flusher — refuses to flush for as
long as doing_sync is set, while the thread that could clear doing_sync is the one
sleeping.

### Why it's rarely seen

run_on_separate_thread is off by default. Triggering also needs (a) a physics call from
the main thread inside the sync window that hits flush_if_pending — any
CollisionObject3D whose transform changes every frame guarantees one — and (b) the pump
mid-pass at that instant, which off-main physics pushes make common. The window itself is
microseconds; at 72 Hz VR with per-frame moving Area3Ds it lands within minutes to hours.

## Suggested directions for a fix

- In _thread_loop, don't drop the wakeup: e.g. flush unconditionally (flushing while
  doing_sync is set was legal for the *main* thread anyway, so the queue contents must
  tolerate it), or loop yield() only when !command_queue.has_pending(), or re-notify
  self when skipping with pending work.
- Or make _flush()'s contention path not rely on a third-party flusher: retry taking the
  flush (re-check flush_read_ptr in a loop) instead of sync().


### System information

 - Meta Quest 3, Android 14 (SQ3A), 72 Hz VR - Godot 4.7.beta1 custom export template (arm64, NDK r29) - GodotPhysics 3D (default server)

### Issue description

With physics/3d/run_on_separate_thread=true, the game hard-freezes intermittently
(minutes to hours). No crash, no ANR: the process keeps compositing its last frame; every
thread is asleep. Two threads are deadlocked:

**Main thread** (frozen mid-Main::iteration, inside the physics sync window):

std::condition_variable::wait
CommandQueueMT::_wait_for_sync                  <- from sync()/push_and_sync(_no_op)
CommandQueueMT::_flush                          <- took the "another thread is flushing" branch
PhysicsServer3DWrapMT::area_set_transform       <- direct branch -> flush_if_pending()
CollisionObject3D::_notification                <- NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED
SceneTree::flush_transform_notifications
SceneTree::physics_process
Main::iteration

**Physics pump task** (a WorkerThreadPool thread):

std::condition_variable::wait
WorkerThreadPool::_wait_collaboratively         <- YIELDING, yield_is_over == false
WorkerThreadPool::yield
PhysicsServer3DWrapMT::_thread_loop

All other WorkerThreadPool threads idle. The state never resolves.


## Minimal reproduction project

- physics/3d/run_on_separate_thread=true
- 64 Area3Ds whose position changes every _physics_process (forces
  area_set_transform from the main thread inside the sync window every tick)
- 4 script Threads each spamming PhysicsServer3D.area_set_transform on standalone RIDs
  (legal off-main server use; supplies the stragglers)
- A watchdog thread prints MAIN LOOP STALLED when _physics_process heartbeats stop.

Expected: alive: physics frame N lines stop and the watchdog fires — typically within a
few minutes on desktop, faster on slower/mobile CPUs. With run_on_separate_thread=false
it runs indefinitely.

[physics_thread_deadlock.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29663439/physics_thread_deadlock.zip)
